# CloudFerro Sherlock

Use `cloudferro-sherlock/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "cloudferro-sherlock-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "cloudferro-sherlock/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `CLOUDFERRO_SHERLOCK_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api-sherlock.cloudferro.com/openai/v1/`

You can override the base URL by setting `CLOUDFERRO_SHERLOCK_BASE_URL`.

- https://docs.sherlock.cloudferro.com/
